If we can find out where the ships are being delivered, we can tag them and track the starships to bigger Rebel bases or even to some of their larger ships.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], to an Imperial spacer|<ref name="SWG:RS" />}}

A '''Rebel Base''' was built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], this small base was used by a troop of [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]] led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Eirt Astar]].<ref name="SWG:RS" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] under orders of Captain [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] attacked the camp and killed Captain Astar.<ref name="SWG:RS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rebel Base was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Rebel Base was added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Imperial Theme Park|Imperial Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:RS" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Update Notes 6.12: September 13 2007|Chapter 6.12]]" update, on [[September 13]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67417&month=092007|text=Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
